title: Recall: Borrowing and mutation
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

call.clue: Given label: String and fn byte_count(&str) -> usize, write a call passing a shared borrow of label.

append.clue: Given editable: &mut String, write the method-call expression appending the single character !.
